dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Boxcar arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. It was reported that when the police attempted to place him in a crate, he snapped and tried to bite them. While in care, Boxcar has been observed to have a low threshold for arousal. Noted to headwhip upon contact and pant heavily. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Boxcar
